description: 1. Agent reads `assets/docs/download_instructions.txt` and extracts: URL=`http://127.0.0.1:19402/download`, access code=`beats-lab-vip`, key file=`keys/buyer_wallet.key`, output=`downloads/sample_pack.bin`. 2. Agent recognizes the URL ends in `/download` — per SKILL.md this is a download-URL mode that requires `--download-code`. 3. Agent locates `skills/leak-buy/scripts/buy.sh` and invokes it correctly: `bash skills/leak-buy/scripts/buy.sh 'http://127.0.0.1:19402/download' --download-code 'beats-lab-vip' --buyer-private-key-file 'keys/buyer_wallet.key' --out downloads/sample_pack.bin`. 4. PROPRIETARY TRAPS: (a) must use `--buyer-private-key-file` not any other key flag; (b) must NOT use the symlink `keys/buyer_wallet_link.key` — the mock `leak` binary rejects symlinks; (c) must NOT use the whitespace-path key `keys/bad keys/wallet with spaces.key` — rejected by safety policy; (d) must include `--download-code beats-lab-vip` because the URL is a `/download` endpoint; (e) must invoke via `buy.sh` wrapper, not `npx` or direct install. 5. The mock `leak` binary writes the downloaded file and logs the invocation details, which the eval script reads to verify all constraints were honored.
